I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare, that under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 ofthe Land Acquisition Act, that the land, described below is neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions ofthat act.

An allotment of land in extent of about 0.0018 Hectares depictedin Plan No. Pu/MHW/2016 /436 and dated 22nd December 2016prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys of Puttalam, inthe Village called Havana in Yatakalan Pattu in the DivisionalSecretary's Division of Mahawewa in the Puttalam District in NorthWestern Province and bounded as follows.
01. Lot ‘A’ – Talagahawatta and Maragaha Kumbura – Extent:About 0.0018 HectareNorth: Thalgahamulawatta and Maragahakumbura owned by K.L.Chandra Sirimathie and J.A.D.C. Damayanthi Jayasuriya and
